All ten parser tests pass, with one change to `lib/cross_shop/ebay_parser.rb` and nothing else touched.

In the re-captured pages eBay renamed the wrapper around each listing's title from `s-card__title` to `s-card__headline`. Nothing else moved: the inner `su-styled-text primary` span, the subtitle rows, prices and attribute rows are unchanged, which is why only the title fill rate dropped to zero and the three title-dependent tests failed. The parser's title selector now accepts either wrapper class, so both the old and new captures parse, with a one-line comment recording the rename. Row recognition by meaning is untouched.

All ten parser tests pass, and both saved pages are back to a full price fill rate.

eBay's only markup change was a currency code in front of every price: the `s-card__price` span now reads `US $99.99`, and range rows read `US $83.00 to US $128.00`. The parser recognised a price row by its text starting with a dollar sign, so every price row fell through to `extensions`, which also broke the downstream converter and health check. The fix, confined to `lib/cross_shop/ebay_parser.rb`, is a `PRICE_ROW` pattern that accepts an optional two-or-three-letter currency code before the amount, and a `CURRENCY_CODE` pattern that strips that code inside `price` so the stored string keeps SearchApi's `$99.99` shape, including the strikethrough original and the range form. Tests pass (10 runs, 32 assertions, 0 failures), and the held-out page parses to 60 listings again.

eBay renamed the search-result card container: each result `<li>` lost its `s-card` class and now carries `s-tile` instead (the `s-card--vertical` modifier and every inner class, such as the title, subtitle, image and attribute rows, are unchanged, and the only remaining `s-card` containers are 12 `<div>`s inside carousels that are not search results). The parser selected cards with `li.s-card`, so it found nothing. I changed that one selector in `lib/cross_shop/ebay_parser.rb` to `li.s-card, li.s-tile`, so it accepts both the old and new container class. Row recognition by content (price, bids, shipping, condition) is untouched.
